title: ICSI Announces 7 New CS Exam Centres for December 2026 Session
content:
# ICSI Announces 7 New CS Exam Centres for December 2026 Session

Ek important update hai Company Secretaries (CS) aspirants ke liye! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne Company Secretaries Examinations ke December 2026 session se, 7 naye exam centres announce kiye hain. Yeh decision students ko aur convenience provide karega.

*   **Announcement Date:** The official announcement was made on September 03, 2026.
*   **Applicable From:** These new centres will be effective from the CS December 2026 session onwards for both CS Executive and Professional Programmes.
*   **New Exam Centres:** The 7 new centres opened on an ad hoc basis are:
    *   Begusarai (Bihar) - Centre Code: 129
    *   Darbhanga (Bihar) - Centre Code: 130
    *   Ayodhya (Uttar Pradesh) - Centre Code: 268
    *   Saharanpur (Uttar Pradesh) - Centre Code: 270
    *   Haridwar (Uttarakhand) - Centre Code: 269
    *   Ratnagiri (Maharashtra) - Centre Code: 492
    *   Rewa (Madhya Pradesh) - Centre Code: 493
*   **Purpose:** This expansion aims to offer candidates more flexibility and options in choosing their examination locations.
*   **How to Opt:** Candidates enrolling for the December 2026 session can now select these new centres in addition to the existing ones during the online enrolment process.
